Every Agent. Every Action. Fully Traced.

Autonomous agents act on their own, and most tools lose track of who set them loose. Kovrr detects rogue and malicious agents and ties every action back to a named user, with continuous behavior monitoring across the environment.

2 min. guided demo. No sales rep.
The AI Inventory That Builds Itself

Spreadsheets go stale the moment a new tool shows up, and shadow AI never announces itself. Kovrr continuously discovers every AI system touching corporate data, from sanctioned platforms to the ones running quietly in the background, and keeps the inventory current with no manual updates.

2 min. guided demo. No sales rep.
From Written Policy to Live Enforcement

Most AI policies live in a document nobody checks at the moment it matters. Kovrr watches AI use across the browser and endpoint, catching sensitive data before it reaches an AI tool and stepping in the instant a rule is broken, so the policy enforces itself in real time.

2 min. guided demo. No sales rep.
Know Which AI Risk to Fix First

A Big4 assessment can hand you a long list of control weaknesses with no sense of which one costs the most. Kovrr quantifies AI risk in financial terms and prioritizes remediation by potential risk reduction, so the number you bring to the board reflects business impact rather than guesswork.

2 min. guided demo. No sales rep.

Security tools only see a sliver. Discover how triangulation reveals the whole in the AI Interaction Data Fabric Insights.

Full-Stack Engineer
Tel Aviv / Hybrid / Remote

We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our Team – someone passionate about building high-quality software and eager to work on innovative, large-scale systems in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

‍

What You’ll Do

‍

  • Build and maintain features across the backend and frontend of our platform.
  • Collaborate with team members from product, design, and data to deliver high-impact solutions.
  • Take part in planning, development, testing, and code reviews.
  • Help improve our development processes and contribute to a great team culture.

What We’re Looking For
‍

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack development.
  • Solid programming skills in Python, Node.JS including building RESTful APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
  • Practical experience with React.js, TypeScript, and Next.js for frontend development.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms AWS, GCP.
  • Experience working with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and understanding basic data modeling.
  • Experience with MongoDB (schema design, performance tuning).
  • Ability to own features end-to-end and thrive in a fast-moving startup.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, communication, and team mindset.
  • Knowledge of contemporary software development practices such as CI/CD, agile methodologies, and test automation.

Nice to Have
‍

  • Experience with container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud-based environments
  • Some experience with AI / Agents / Prompt Engineering / ML-driven features.

Why Join Kovrr?
‍

  • Work on meaningful, cutting-edge technology that helps organizations make better decisions.
  • Join a smart, supportive, and collaborative team where your voice is heard.
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements and a healthy work-life balance.
  • Grow your skills and career in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
